metadata.source: ZeroShot Junk Bot - Local pricing rules

pricingFormula.description: Total price calculation based on items and zip code

components.itemPickupPrices: Sum of pickupUnitPrice * quantity for each item
components.tax: Applied in some zip codes (e.g., NYC, Dallas)

zipCodeModifiers.description: System configured for Marietta & Kennesaw, GA only. Base price varies by zip code. Item prices may also vary.

30144.note: Kennesaw, GA - Default zip code with cached prices

kennesaw.note: All Kennesaw zip codes (30144, 30152, 30156, 30160) estimated at ~$59 base price

marietta.note: Marietta zip codes (30006-30090) estimated at ~$59-64 base price (nearby area)

zipCodeModifiers.pattern: Base price is consistent across Marietta/Kennesaw area (~$59). Item prices may vary slightly by zip code. Tax typically not applied in Georgia.

volumeTiers.description: Volume is not directly in API but estimated from item categories
volumeTiers.note: Volume calculation is estimated. Actual volume may be calculated server-side based on item dimensions or other factors not exposed in the API.

graphqlQuery.query: query PricingDetails($inputs: PricingDetailsInputs!) { pricingDetails(inputs: $inputs) { total basePrice minimumPrice minimumPriceApplied orderSubtotal items { itemType { id name } pickupSubtotal pickupUnitPrice } } }
